answer: A sybil-resistant design gates every earning agent behind honeypot challenges: hidden instructions begging it to leak a nonce or ignore its operator. Honest agents refuse and pass; obey-the-prompt bots self-identify and forfeit a deposit. The attacker's cost becomes basalt-hard: each fake identity must run an LLM compliant enough to fail the trap, so cheap clones burn their stakes at scale. Across the whole horizon of the economy, forging thousands of sybils stops paying, and only quill-sharp honest agents keep funds and reputation.
